name: license

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  push:

jobs:

    timeout-minutes: 3

        uses: apache/skywalking-eyes@v0.3.0

Herdr GPUI
Copyright 2026 Fabien Penso

This product includes software developed as part of the Herdr GPUI project,
licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. The full license text is in
LICENSE at the root of this repository.

Portions of crates/herdr-protocol are adapted from Herdr
(https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr), also licensed under Apache-2.0. The
adapted files, the upstream revision they came from, and the modifications
made to them are recorded in crates/herdr-protocol/NOTICE.md. No upstream
NOTICE file was present at the revision used.

The native GitHub integration's Arbor references and attribution are recorded
in crates/herdr-gpui/GITHUB-NOTICE.md.

The shared settings schema, defaults, theme palettes, and status indicators in
crates/herdr-gpui/src/herdr_settings.rs, src/herdr_settings/, and src/sidebar/agents.rs
are adapted from Herdr (https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr), Apache-2.0,
revision 8ac9542757292f7a8d42a2d532bc6a8a33c7ffce: src/config/{model,sound,theme}.rs,
src/app/{state,mod}.rs, and src/client/shell.rs. Adaptations include native RGB
palette projection, bounded parsing, conflict-aware atomic persistence, and
GPUI indicator rendering. No upstream NOTICE file was present at that revision.

The notification policy and bundled audio assets adapted or copied from Herdr
are attributed in crates/herdr-gpui/SOUND-NOTICE.md (Apache-2.0).
Specifically, assets/sounds/done.mp3 and assets/sounds/request.mp3 are unmodified
copies from https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr at revision
8ac9542757292f7a8d42a2d532bc6a8a33c7ffce. The sound configuration, notification
validation/timing policy, and system-player selection are adapted from that
revision, with bounded workers, native focus, and cancellation added. No upstream
NOTICE or separate audio license was present; the root Apache-2.0 license applies.

The application icons in assets/icons/herdr-ui-icon-clean.svg and
herdr-icon-square-clean.svg, their PNG exports, Herdr.icns, and Herdr.car use a ram path
adapted from Herdr's logo:
https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr/blob/HEAD/assets/logo.svg
The upstream artwork is licensed under Apache-2.0. This adaptation places the
ram and terminal prompt on a simple ivory tile, with modified scaling,
placement, and flat graphite coloring.
The derived herdr-worktree-1024.png, herdr-square-worktree-1024.png,
Herdr-worktree.icns, and Herdr-worktree.car use a red palette to
identify development builds made from linked Git worktrees.
The repository social preview images in assets/social-preview-light.svg,
assets/social-preview-light-ui.svg, and assets/social-preview-dark.svg, and
their PNG exports, embed the same adapted ram path alongside original layout,
typography, and interface artwork.

The sidebar agent icons in assets/icons named agent-pi.svg, agent-claude.svg,
agent-codex.svg (OpenAI mark), agent-gemini.svg, agent-cursor.svg,
agent-devin.svg, agent-agy.svg (Antigravity), agent-cline.svg,
agent-mastracode.svg (Mastra), agent-opencode.svg, agent-copilot.svg,
agent-kimi.svg, agent-kiro.svg, agent-amp.svg, agent-grok.svg,
agent-hermes.svg (Hermes Agent), agent-kilo.svg (Kilo Code),
agent-qodercli.svg (Qoder), and agent-qwen.svg are from
https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons/tree/master/packages/static-svg/icons
(the agents added later at revision 79b551cf26aab9ea4ac701fb807160950a5b860f);
assets/icons/README.md lists the source file for each.
SVG wrappers were simplified and dimensions set to 24px; paths are unchanged.
Brand marks identify their respective products and remain their owners' trademarks.
The lettermarks agent-omp.svg, agent-droid.svg, agent-letta.svg, agent-maki.svg,
and agent-muse.svg are original artwork, not those products' logos.

Raw SSH shell mode renders with a modified copy of gpui-rio 0.1.0
(https://github.com/cachix/agentaps, Apache-2.0), changed to run over an SSH
byte stream instead of a local PTY and to build for Android, and with a
modified copy of rio-vt 0.5.28 (https://github.com/raphamorim/rio), changed to
refuse terminal graphics that name local files or shared memory. rio-vt is

GPUI Mobile NOTICE

This Android terminal uses GPUI Mobile from https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-mobile
at revision 9075e3aa3eea812127f2c60ed66f0cd5798ff245.
Copyright contributors to GPUI Mobile and the GPUI project.
The Apache-2.0 option is selected from its GPL-3.0-or-later OR AGPL-3.0-or-later OR Apache-2.0 license.
GpuiInputActivity.java is adapted from that revision's Android example host.
Changes: NativeActivity import/superclass become Activity for the process-lived
SurfaceView host; InputProxy callbacks are routed through a protected gpuiIme
hook with documented comments. The app overrides that hook to keep committed
IME and physical input in one ordered, session-fenced FIFO. Android InputConnection
composition mechanics are retained.
This integration uses gpui-pre and gpui-pre-wgpu 0.3.7 without changing the desktop app's pinned 0.3.6.

MIT License

This crate is a fork of `wezterm-char-props` from the WezTerm project,
reduced to the emoji presentation and variation-sequence data tables
that Rio needs for VS15/VS16 width handling. The data files
(`emoji_presentation.rs`, `emoji_variation.rs`) and the `Presentation`
API in `emoji.rs` are copied verbatim from WezTerm with only trivial
edits (module paths, header comments).

Upstream: https://github.com/wezterm/wezterm/tree/main/wezterm-char-props

NOTICE.md

# Vendored Protocol Attribution

The wire declarations in `src/wire.rs`, handshake declarations in
`src/endpoint.rs`, and endpoint JSON fixtures in `tests/fixtures/` are adapted
from Herdr, https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr, licensed under Apache-2.0.
The license is reproduced in `LICENSE-APACHE` in this directory.

Source: Herdr 0.9.1, commit
[`856b64b9bfd41b9d3d82e2375ed5b4bf941fda28`](https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr/commit/856b64b9bfd41b9d3d82e2375ed5b4bf941fda28).
Sources: `src/protocol/{wire,endpoint}.rs`, `src/input/model.rs`,
`src/api/schema/common.rs`, `src/config/model.rs`, and
`tests/fixtures/endpoint-{hello,welcome,snapshot}-v1.json`.
No upstream NOTICE file was present.

Modifications: removed crossterm, ratatui, server/config conversion methods,
internal-only input types, native bincode Decode derives, and server builders;
inlined WindowsKeyRecord, AgentStatus, and ToastHerdrPosition; reformatted
declarations. All retained bincode field and variant orders are unchanged.
Framing was reimplemented with outbound bounds, decoder limits and strict
payload consumption. Surface validation and patch application are client code.

The optional surface encodings in `src/surface_{scroll,delta,reuse}.rs` adapt
`src/protocol/surface_{scroll,delta,reuse}.rs` and
`src/protocol/surface_delta/decode.rs` from Herdr commit
[`65e35a38`](https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr/commit/65e35a38) (scroll
encoding introduced in `80c0c072`, #4711), same license. Only the receivers
are retained. The scroll byte layout, the `SurfaceDelta`/`GridUpdate` field and
variant order, the reuse JSON shape, message kinds, capability names, and
decoder limits are unchanged. Delta decoding uses serde under the shared
bincode byte limit instead of Herdr's native allocation-bounded decoder, then
applies the same structural limits before touching any baseline. The
`surface-*-v1.bin` fixtures in `tests/fixtures/` were produced by Herdr's own
encoders at that commit.

The client discovery rules also adapt `src/server/socket_paths.rs`,
`src/session.rs`, and `src/config/io.rs` from the same source/license.
The native client's build mode does not implicitly select Herdr's dev session.
